raw.core_excitement: The founder is excited by the prospect of a single system that observes how work happens, decides what AI should do next, and auto-builds agents continuously to ensure "Continuous AI lift."
raw.what_makes_this_different: Its three-layered architecture (Observe, Intelligence, Execution) that leverages existing foundation models to create a "Work Graph" for continuous AI automation, rather than building its own LLMs.
raw.product_description: Narma is an "Enterprise Agentic Brain" designed for AI-first companies. It comprises three layers: Observe (Layer 1) with desktop sensors to capture work patterns; Intelligence Layer (Layer 2) a "Brain" detecting employee intent, task value, and workflow "drift"; and Execution Layer (Layer 3) an "Agent Factory" for automated AI agent generation, deployment, and monitoring. It focuses on a "Work Graph" and uses existing foundation models to provide "Continuous AI lift."
raw.thesis: Narma proposes an "Enterprise Agentic Brain" for AI-first companies to implement AI automation at scale. The core innovation lies in its three-layered architecture: an observation layer (Layer 1) using lightweight desktop sensors to capture work patterns; an intelligence layer (Layer 2) that acts as a "Brain" to detect employee intent, task value, and workflow "drift"; and an execution layer (Layer 3) with an "Agent Factory" that automates the generation, deployment, and monitoring of AI agents for high-ROI opportunities. This system aims to provide "Continuous AI lift" by observing work, deciding AI actions, and continuously building agents. Narma does not build its own LLMs but focuses on leveraging existing foundation models within a "Work Graph" framework to identify areas for AI intervention and optimization. The target users are AI-first companies, specifically those seeking to enhance their AI automation capabilities. The problem Narma addresses is the difficulty these companies face in identifying, proving, and deploying AI automation effectively, leading to wasted resources and missed optimization opportunities. The founder's goal, while not explicitly stated, appears to be a growth startup given the ambitious vision of enterprise-wide AI automation. This venture is currently at the idea stage, with the architecture and vision clearly articulated but no evidence of a built product or user traction. Narma aims to complement existing AI solutions by providing an overarching system for orchestrating and optimizing AI agent deployment, rather than replacing core AI models. It sits above foundational AI models, integrating with them to deliver real-world business value through automation.
raw.one_liner: Narma is an "Enterprise Agentic Brain" for AI-first companies to see, prove, and deploy AI automation at scale.
